title: I made Claude actually playtest my Unity game: scene probes, scripted Play Mode, and host + client with latency (free, MIT)
author: Dapper-Librarian5140
selftext:
Claude Code can now drive the Unity Editor through Unity's Pipeline CLI. I packaged what I learned into a skill: it probes scenes, plays features through the game's real input path, runs a host + client session with simulated latency, and writes a pass/fail report that keeps "verified by script" apart from "needs a human".



I treated token cost as a design goal. In v0.2 the skill made small requests more expensive than not using it (168k vs 147k tokens), so v0.3 added a fast path that brought it down to about 74k.



Free, MIT: [https://github.com/GhazaGG/Unity-Playtest-for-Claude](https://github.com/GhazaGG/Unity-Playtest-for-Claude)
